# Append Jackson serializer config to the three persistence services
for svc in orders inventory customers; do
cat >> $svc/src/main/resources/application.properties <<'EOF'

# --- implementation config (added) ---
# Use Jackson for events/commands/queries (records serialize cleanly; XStream needs allowlisting).
axon.serializer.general=jackson
axon.serializer.events=jackson
axon.serializer.messages=jackson
# Give Axon's JPA token/saga stores room and a stable boot.
spring.jpa.open-in-view=false
EOF
done
# Edge: serializer + omit null JSON fields (reason/total) on responses

# --- implementation config (added) ---
axon.serializer.general=jackson
axon.serializer.events=jackson
axon.serializer.messages=jackson
# Omit null reason/total in Order/Notification responses (present-iff semantics).
spring.jackson.default-property-inclusion=non_null
EOF
